*   **Research Question:** Gut microbiome modulation of ICI efficacy in solid tumors & mechanisms.
*   **Key Materials:**
    *   P0096 (Review on Lung Cancer Microbiome): NSCLC specific, Akkermansia, Faecalibacterium, antibiotic effects.
    *   P0146 (Review on Gut Microbiota shapes cancer immunotherapy): General mechanisms, taxa lists.
    *   P0478 (Cross-cohort melanoma study): **Crucial.** "No universal biomarker", PERMANOVA shows "cohort" explains 10x variance, ML AUC-ROC 0.59-0.60 cross-cohort.

    *   P0270 (mCRPC): Akkermansia *negative* correlation. Stability during treatment.
    *   P0545 (Polish melanoma): F. prausnitzii *negative* (non-responders).
    *   P0204 (HCC multi-kingdom): Bacteria/metabolites differ, fungi less so.
    *   P0393 (Multi-kingdom): C2 subtype (high diversity) better.
